name: Headship
overview: Scripture reveals that headship is a divine order established within marriage, where the husband is called to be the spiritual head of his wife, reflecting Christ's headship over the church. This relationship is characterized by loving leadership and sacrificial care, as husbands are commanded to love their wives as Christ loved the church and gave Himself for it. Wives are instructed to submit to their husbands as to the Lord, within a mutual context of submission to one another out of reverence for God. Together, these passages affirm a God-ordained structure that unites husband and wife as one flesh while emphasizing Christ-centered love and respect.
